summary: Checks whether a value is an integer.
description: A number with no fractional part. Nothing is coerced, so the string `"42"` is not an integer, and `NaN` is not either.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is an integer; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isInteger(42); // => true
isInteger(-7); // => true
isInteger(0); // => true
isInteger(1.5); // => false
isInteger(NaN); // => false
isInteger("42"); // => false
```
